item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-09-29
item.description: Three institutionally dense placements on the same unsolved institutional object this series' prior thirty-nine briefings have been documenting — the institutional identity of Chinese open source across institutional borders — and all three placements this cycle's briefing documents sit at institutional layers this series' prior briefings have not documented at before. (1) The InnerSource China Summit 2026 Shanghai (2026-09-22/23, InnerSource Commons + COPU + CSDN + OpenTekr) documents the first Chinese InnerSource movement crossing company boundaries into government and industry, with the US SHARE IT Act (2024), Saudi Cabinet Resolution 14 (2024), Singapore SGTS unified technology stack, and Shenzhen Longgang's Longyuan Platform (20 business domains / 21 MCP tools / 94 Skills / 182 accounts / 56 applications as of 2026-09-20) as the inter-national-plus-sub-national-government anchor layer, plus Bosch's 17-year Unblock-Empower-Drive three-step-path (Georg Grütter), BaiDu's from-connected-to-usable organizational-upgrade (Dong Shuzhao), and the Context-over-Control 17-year lineage from Netflix 2009 → Zhang Yiming 2017 → Liang Rukuo 2026-06 (Tan Zhongyi). (2) The CSST 2026 New Industry Standardization Leading Forum's Open Source Standards and Ecosystem Building sub-forum announcement (2026-10-13/14 Beijing, CESI/CSST hosting, "Establish Standards, Open New Bureaus, Create the Future" theme, implementing the "New Industry Standardization Leading Project" of the 15th Five-Year Plan) documents a seven-module Chinese-Open-Source-Administrative-Toolkit being operationalized as a single institutional-form object: SJ/T 12304-2026 Large Model Technical System Open Open Grading Assessment Specification (China's first national-level LLM open-source grading industry standard), Large Model Open-Source License Compliance and Data Insights, Large Model Judicial Dynamics and Rule Analysis, Industrial Software and Electric Power Industry Open-Source Innovation Ecosystem Building, openEuler Community Future Open-Source Development, Mulan Open-Source Community New Incubation Projects Launch Ceremony, and the CSST-plus-15th-Five-Year-Plan strategic-deployment anchor. (3) The Thought-Steel (思想钢印) + Huxiu (虎嗅) 2026-09-26 essay "The Most Successful Part of the Chinese Internet May Be the Biggest Problem for AI Agents" documents the "China has no web pages anymore" infrastructure constraint as the structural reason why consumer-grade AI agents perform strikingly in demonstrations but cannot execute in practice in China — with the concrete institutional-evidence layer of Meta Muse at 2 million+ prompts per week in North America (as of 2026-09-26) surpassing ChatGPT on the free chart in the US and Canada, the browser-as-cross-company-standard-operating-system layer as the structural reason why Muse works in the US and does not work in China, the packaging-is-friendly-for-humans-not-for-AI framing as the sharpest structural observation, the Doubao-phone cross-app operation sequentially blocked by WeChat and Taobao, and the three forward paths for Chinese consumer-grade AI agents (Super-App-Native Agent with WeChat most likely + Tech-Giant-Ecosystem-Native Agent with Alibaba Qwen / ByteDance AI phone + Phone-Manufacturer IoT Agent with Xiaomi IoT).
